description: Searches 1045 INAVI Maps place-category codes for South Korea by name and returns the codes. Runs locally — no API call. USAGE: call it first whenever you need a catecode for search_nearby_category. search_places takes the same codes. Category names are in Korean. NOTE: codes are a six-digit hierarchy, so searching "편의점" (110700) also returns leaf codes such as GS25 and CU. Use the parent code for a whole category, a leaf code for one brand.

query.description: Category name or code to look up. Names match on substrings, in Korean (for example "편의점", "충전소", "치과", or the code "110700").

name: lookup_category_code

code.description: Category code. Pass it straight to catecode

path.description: Full path through the parent categories

title: Look up a place category code
